definitions.full: H5773. ivim עִוְעִים noun plural abstract distorting, warping (for * עַוְעֲוִים ); — עִוְעִים רוּחַ Isa 19:14 temper of distorting , i.e. warped judgment.

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
